title: Did Roberts pay you yet?
html_source: George Roberts. Publisher of Dubliners. (Frank Delaney’s re:Joyce 189, Of Cabbages & Combs)

anchor.prefix: to try jotting down on my cuff what she said dressing. Dislike dressing together. Nicked myself shaving. Biting her nether lip, hooking the placket of her skirt. Timing her. 9.l5.

9.20. What had Gretta Conroy on? 9.23. What possessed me to buy this comb? 9.24. I'm swelled after that cabbage. A speck of dust on the patent leather of her boot.
